about: Dennisisdebeste's own plays in the Level Lab and the Level Factory (claude.ai pages), every try with its taps: [tile, ms since start, 0 taken / 1 turned over / 2 nothing]. Lab boards: lv 10000+id in lab-clears.json. Factory boards are included here. verdict: easy / right / hard (his judgement of the difficulty). bot: Codex's measure() tries for salts 1-3 when the factory made the board (wip/personal-bots 2330bad).
